# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to **support@up.computer**. Do not include
secrets, access tokens, personal data, or exploit details in a public GitHub issue.

Include the affected version, operating system, reproduction steps, expected impact, and any
suggested mitigation. You should receive an acknowledgement within a reasonable time, but no fixed
response or remediation deadline is promised while the project is in alpha.

Do not access data that is not yours, disrupt services, or perform destructive testing. Good-faith,
non-destructive reports are welcome.

## Supported versions

Up.computer is currently alpha software. Security fixes are normally shipped in the latest release;
older releases are not guaranteed to receive backports.
